notes.title: Major Changes Coming to Loot and Stats!
notes.notes:
[h1]Loot will be receiving a facelift in the next update for the Shadows of Morhaven demo[/h1]

[b]Hey Kingsguard! [/b]
Base stats have been tweaked for each item, and rarity of the item will now determine how much said base stats will scale, with [b]Common [/b]items receiving base values, and [b]Legendary [/b]items receiving [b]+60% [/b]on base values.
This means that a shortsword, for example, with a base of [b]25 STR[/b] will receive a[b] +15[/b], making it [b]40 STR[/b] at [b]Legendary [/b]rarity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45399362/a06e9d304de34dd15c66ac515940ace1a2fe4b26.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45399362/b92eed85ecf2a472e6313148d6309100788c88fe.jpg[/img]
See the above images for a comparison of a [b]Common [/b]vs [b]Legendary [/b]shortsword.

Additionally, as you can see in the above images, each stat roll will have it's own randomly selected tier, ranging from 1-5. Each tier has progressively higher possible values, but are consequentially more rare. In the above image, There were 3 stat rolls, with one receiving the lowest tier, T1. There is one T2, and one T3. Each tier has a range of bonuses that can be awarded, with the caps increasing with each tier.

I think this is a step in the right direction toward making loot more exciting, while also adding a bit more RNG to keep things interesting.

I'd love to hear your feedback in the replies on this post, or in the Discord server. 

[b]Thanks for reading![/b]
-Casey AKA QuestDev

notes.title: Shadows of Morhaven Joins NextFest – Updated Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, adventurers![/h1]

I'm very thrilled to announce that [i]Shadows of Morhaven[/i] is officially part of [b]Steam NextFest[/b]! I encourage you to head over to the demo page where you can experience the latest demo update, featuring [b]new content, bug fixes, and gameplay improvements[/b] tailored to fix up and improve the game based on a ton of community feedback since it's release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45399362/07789fc5b1c431fc471b3b477804138cdac29912.jpg[/img]

This is your chance to step into the dark and mysterious world of Morhaven, battle fearsome gobbies (any perhaps more!), and uncover the sinister forces lurking in the shadows.
